title: Quantum Kernel Estimation for the Discovery of Early Lung Cancer Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.19304v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lung cancer screening with low-dose chest computed tomography reduces mortality, but its impact is limited by uptake, adherence, and management challenges. Blood-based cell-free DNA (cfDNA) biomarkers offer a complementary approach, although early detection remains difficult because of lung cancer heterogeneity and high-dimensional, nonlinear molecular signals. We evaluated quantum-classical hybrid machine learning for lung cancer detection using DNA fragmentomics and DNA methylation. After feature selection, models were trained using 20- and 40-feature subsets. Features were encoded into quantum Hilbert space using angle and dense-angle feature maps with multiple entanglement strategies. Fidelity-based quantum kernels were computed with exact statevector simulation and integrated with precomputed-kernel SVM and kernel-PCA logistic regression and compared with an SVM model trained on the original features. translated_title: 量子核估计用于早期肺癌检测的发现
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19304v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：使用低剂量胸部计算机断层扫描进行肺癌筛查可降低死亡率，但其效果受限于筛查参与率、依从性和管理挑战。基于血液的游离DNA（cfDNA）生物标志物提供了一种补充方法，但由于肺癌的异质性以及高维、非线性的分子信号，早期检测仍然困难。我们评估了量子-经典混合机器学习在肺癌检测中的应用，利用DNA片段组学和DNA甲基化数据。在特征选择后，使用20个和40个特征子集训练模型。特征通过角度和密集角度特征映射以及多种纠缠策略编码到量子希尔伯特空间。基于保真度的量子核通过精确态矢量模拟计算，并与预计算核支持向量机（SVM）和核主成分分析逻辑回归集成，与在原始特征上训练的SVM模型进行了比较。该框架实现了系统性评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于量子-经典混合机器学习的框架，利用DNA片段组学和甲基化特征，通过量子核估计和特征映射策略，实现了对早期肺癌的检测，并展示了优于传统SVM的潜力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a quantum-classical hybrid machine learning framework that leverages DNA fragmentomics and methylation features, using quantum kernel estimation and feature mapping strategies for early lung cancer detection, demonstrating potential advantages over traditional SVM.
